001: I'm thinking about taking a trip next week, but I don't know where to go.
What a great idea! Do you prefer the beach or do you prefer a city with monuments?
I would love the beach, I need to rest a bit from work.
Then I recommend going to Valencia, it has some beautiful beaches.
And how can I get there from Madrid?
You can take the high-speed train, it takes less than two hours.
002: Have you already looked at the hotel prices for our trip?
Yes, I've been comparing and there's one that's very well located and cheap.
What area is it in? I'd like to be close to the center.
It's right next to the cathedral, so we'll be able to walk everywhere.
Perfect! So, should we book it now to secure the room?
Yes, I think it's better to do it today because there are few rooms left.
003: I don't know what clothes to put in the suitcase for the trip to Seville.
Check the weather forecast, because there it can be hot during the day and cool at night.
You're right, better to bring light clothes and a thin jacket.
And don't forget to bring comfortable shoes, because we're going to walk a lot.
True, the streets in the center are beautiful but they feel long.
Well, you know, small suitcase and comfortable shoes.
004: What do you think about renting a car to get around the island?
I think it's a great option, that way we can visit hidden coves.
Do you know if we need any special permit to drive there?
No, the European driver's license is enough.
Great, then let's rent it for two days.
Okay, I'll take care of finding the best deals.
005: I'm looking for flights to go to Lisbon next month.
Have you already decided which days you want to travel?
I'd like to leave on a Thursday morning and come back on Sunday afternoon.
If you can be flexible with the schedule, flights are cheaper during the week.
Okay, I'll take a look at the Thursday options.
And don't forget to only check a carry-on bag to save money.
006: Have you thought about which places you want to visit in Granada?
I really want to see the Alhambra, but I've heard you have to book in advance.
Yes, tickets sell out very quickly, we should buy them now.
And what else do you feel like doing there?
I'd like to get lost in the Albaicín neighborhood and see the views.
Good idea! They say the sunsets from there are spectacular.
007: I'm a bit worried because I can't find accommodation for the holidays.
Have you tried looking on the outskirts? Sometimes there are more options and they're cheaper.
I hadn't thought of that, but I don't mind taking the bus to get to the center.
Of course, and that way you also get to know other areas of the city.
I'm going to look right now at what's available there.
If you want, later I'll help you compare the options.
008: What's our plan for eating on the first day of the trip?
I've booked a table at a typical restaurant that's near the museum.
How nice! I feel like trying the local food.
Yes, I've read very good reviews about their paella and their fresh fish.
I'm glad you've thought of everything.
Well, I just want you to enjoy the trip as much as I will.
009: Do you think we should get travel insurance for this adventure?
Yes, it's a good idea, especially if we're going to do adventure activities.
And what kind of activities are we planning to do?
I wanted to suggest a hiking route through the mountains.
That sounds perfect to me, so let's look for insurance that covers sports.
Okay, this afternoon I'll start comparing options.
010: We already have the train tickets, do you think we should also buy the museum tickets?
Yes, it's better to buy them online to avoid the lines.
And what time would you like to go in to organize the day?
I prefer to go early in the morning, when there are fewer people.
Then I'll book the tickets for ten o'clock.
Great! That way in the afternoon we can stroll around peacefully.
